label: Browserless browse
description: Render a URL in a remote headless Chrome (Browserless /content) — last resort when Crawl4AI returns empty or the page needs real JS

description_i18n.en: Render a URL in a remote headless Chrome (Browserless /content) — last resort when Crawl4AI returns empty or the page needs real JS
description_i18n.zh_CN: 用远程无头 Chrome（Browserless /content）渲染页面——Crawl4AI 正文为空或强依赖 JS 时的后备方案
description_i18n.zh_HK: 用遠端無頭 Chrome（Browserless /content）渲染頁面——Crawl4AI 正文為空或強依賴 JS 時的後備方案

propose_guide: BEST WHEN: crawl4ai/fetch failed, returned empty, or NL explicitly says the site is SPA / JS-rendered / bot-protected and a real browser is required. Costlier and slower than crawl4ai/fetch — do NOT use as the default fetch for every URL. Prefer after searxng/search (or tavily) selected a specific URL. Returns truncated HTML text for downstream summarize. Owner MUST configure blocked_url_hosts against intranet/metadata. Optional require_human via Governance if browser minutes are expensive.

propose_guide_i18n.en: BEST WHEN: crawl4ai/fetch failed, returned empty, or NL explicitly says the site is SPA / JS-rendered / bot-protected and a real browser is required. Costlier and slower than crawl4ai/fetch — do NOT use as the default fetch for every URL. Prefer after searxng/search (or tavily) selected a specific URL. Returns truncated HTML text for downstream summarize. Owner MUST configure blocked_url_hosts against intranet/metadata. Optional require_human via Governance if browser minutes are expensive.
propose_guide_i18n.zh_CN: 最佳场景：crawl4ai/fetch 失败/空正文，或用户明确说 SPA/强 JS/反爬需要真浏览器。比 crawl4ai 更贵更慢，不要默认每条 URL 都用。应在 searxng/search（或 Tavily）选定具体链接后使用。返回截断 HTML 供下游摘要。Owner 必须配置 blocked_url_hosts 防内网/元数据。若浏览器分钟昂贵，可在 Governance 打开人工确认。
propose_guide_i18n.zh_HK: 最佳場景：crawl4ai/fetch 失敗/空正文，或用戶明確說 SPA/強 JS/反爬需要真瀏覽器。比 crawl4ai 更貴更慢，不要預設每條 URL 都用。應在 searxng/search（或 Tavily）選定具體連結後使用。返回截斷 HTML 供下游摘要。Owner 必須配置 blocked_url_hosts 防內網/元數據。若瀏覽器分鐘昂貴，可在 Governance 打開人工確認。

params.name: url
params.description: http(s) URL to render in headless Chrome
params.propose_hint: Only after a search step or explicit URL; prefer crawl4ai/fetch first.

params.name: stealth
params.description: Pass stealth=true launch query when using Browserless cloud

blocked_url_hosts.label: Blocked URL hosts
blocked_url_hosts.description: Reject when the target URL host matches (SSRF / internal host guard).

max_content_length.label: Max HTML characters
max_content_length.description: Owner hint for truncating rendered HTML.

require_human_confirm.label: Require human before browse
require_human_confirm.description: When true, platform may intercept (pair with Governance UI / Track B if enabled).
